title: Clone URL safety: allow-list, credential redaction and pre-spawn refusal
scenario: 1) cloneUrlProblem on https://h/r.git, http://h/r, ssh://git@h/r, git@host:org/r.git, then ext::sh -c 'x', fd::3, file:///x, '-oProxy', 'a b', https://u:pw@h/r. 2) redactUrl on 'fatal: https://user:tok@host/r.git failed', a user@-only URL, an ssh:// URL, text with two URLs, scp-like git@host:path. 3) With child_process.execFile stubbed, cloneRepository with 'ext::sh -c x' and https://u:pw@h/r, then a valid URL with and without a branch.
expected: 1) First four return undefined; ext::, fd::, file://, leading '-', whitespace/control chars and password URLs each return a message; isAllowedCloneUrl mirrors it. 2) Every scheme://user[:pw]@ becomes scheme://; text without userinfo and scp-like form are unchanged. 3) Unsafe URLs throw 'Unsupported git URL' with redacted URL and execFile is not called; valid call has -c protocol.ext.allow=never and protocol.fd.allow=never before 'clone', '--' before the url, '--branch <b>' only when a branch is given.

title: Never clobber user work: cloneable check, dirty detection, migration plan
scenario: 1) isTenantFolderCloneable on memory-fs: missing folder; only generated README.md files plus .reltio-ide; BusinessConfig.json present; extra file beside a README; readDirectory throwing a non-ENOENT error. 2) hasUncommittedChanges with stubbed git: non-repo folder; empty 'status --porcelain'; repo with output; git throwing. 3) planMigration on a tenant with only L3.reltio.json and history/; one whose destination already exists; one already on the component tree.
expected: 1) Missing and README-only trees are cloneable; any real file gives false; non-ENOENT errors propagate. 2) Non-repo false; clean false; output true; git failure returns true (assume dirty so migration is refused). 3) Moves list only present legacy entries; an existing destination is skipped; a migrated tree yields empty moves.

title: Git failure mapping: missing-branch detection, describeGitFailure, BranchNotFoundError
scenario: 1) isMissingBranchFailure with stderr 'Remote branch X not found in upstream origin', 'warning: Could not find remote branch', "pathspec 'x' did not match" and branches 'feature/(x', 'a+b'. 2) describeGitFailure with {code:'ENOENT'}, {killed:true}, an Error whose message holds https://u:p@h/r, and a plain string. 3) cloneRepository with execFile rejecting 'Remote branch dev not found in upstream origin' (branch passed) and a generic failure (no branch).
expected: 1) Known wordings true; unrelated stderr false; special-character branches neither throw nor match wrong text ('a+b' vs 'aab'). 2) ENOENT gives GitNotFoundError mentioning PATH; killed gives a timeout message in minutes; credentials removed; a clean Error is returned as the same object. 3) Branch case throws BranchNotFoundError(branch,url) with redacted URL; other failures go through describeGitFailure; no branch never throws BranchNotFoundError.

source: src/workspace/gitSourceMarker.ts readMultiGitSourceMarker / readGitSourceMarker / ensureGitignoreEntries / ensureMarkerGitignored / write/readTenantIdentityMarker; src/workspace/tenantFolderStructure.ts COMPONENT_FOLDERS / path constants
title: Git marker, gitignore and layout constants: parsing, idempotence, round-trip, stability
scenario: 1) Marker reader on legacy single object, {sources:[valid,valid]}, {sources:[valid,{tenantId:1}]}, invalid JSON, missing file. 2) ensureMarkerGitignored on a missing .gitignore, one with '.reltio-ide' (no slash) and CRLF, one without trailing newline; run twice. 3) Write then read a tenant marker {kind:'tenant',environmentName,tenantId} and an environment marker; read with no marker. 4) Assert BUSINESS_CONFIG_FILE, IDE_STATE_DIR, BASELINE_FILE, LAYOUT_FILE, MIGRATION_BACKUP_DIR values; every COMPONENT_FOLDERS entry has a docsUrl and none is in RETIRED_COMPONENT_FOLDERS.
expected: 1) Legacy wraps into {sources:[x]}; valid multi returned as is; invalid entry, bad JSON or missing file gives undefined without throwing; readGitSourceMarker returns first source or undefined. 2) File created when absent; alternate spellings not duplicated; unrelated lines preserved; newline inserted before append; second run writes nothing; workspace variant adds .reltio-ide-backup/. 3) Values round-trip exactly; write also updates .gitignore; absent marker gives undefined. 4) Names match the documented git layout; renaming one is caught because it would orphan user repositories.

source: src/workspace/tenantGitBinding.ts bindTenantToGit (empty folder) / adoptExistingFolder via bindTenantToGit / bindTenantToGit (branch missing) / createBranchFromDefault / dropInheritedConfiguration
title: Bind tenant to Git: clone, adopt, declined branch, new branch from default
scenario: 1) Empty tenant folder, valid https URL, branch 'dev' present on remote. 2) Populated non-repo folder with Business Config/BusinessConfig.json, stubbed git recording args; repeat with an existing .git. 3) Remote branch missing and confirmCreateBranch false on clone and adopt paths; then true with push failing, and with an empty remote. 4) Clone path, branch absent, default branch has BusinessConfig.json: create the branch.
expected: 1) Outcome {kind:'cloned',branch:'dev'}; component tree, identity marker and .gitignore entries written; confirmCreateBranch not called. 2) init -b, remote add origin, fetch origin <b>, reset origin/<b> (mixed, never --hard), set-upstream-to; 'adopted'; BusinessConfig.json bytes unchanged; existing .git throws 'already a Git repository'. 3) Declined: 'declined', no marker or tree, adopt path deletes the .git it created. Confirmed: branch-created, branch-created-not-pushed or initialized-empty-remote, no data loss. 4) checkout -b <branch>, git rm of BUSINESS_CONFIG_FILE (staged, not committed), push -u origin; a git rm failure is ignored; component folders and READMEs untouched.

title: Layout migration: backup-first, blocked on dirty/backup failure, idempotent, undo
scenario: 1) migrateTenant on a legacy tenant (config, baseline, layout, history) with a Memento stub; then fs.rename throwing for one move and re-run. 2) hasUncommittedChanges true; separately backup fs.copy throwing. 3) migrateWorkspace twice over one legacy tenant and one component-tree tenant. 4) Migrate a tenant then undoMigration; also with no backup folder.
expected: 1) Backup under .reltio-ide-backup/<env>/<tenant> exists before any move; files byte-identical at new paths; stamp only after all moves; rename failure returns 'move-failed' with no stamp. 2) Skip reason 'dirty-worktree' or 'backup-failed' with detail; no files moved, no stamp, legacy files intact. 3) First run migrated=1 with backupRoot; second migrated=0, no skips, backupRoot undefined, contents unchanged. 4) Legacy files restored with original bytes, migrated copies removed, stamp cleared; no backup returns restored=[] and touches nothing.

title: Prune removes only generated-only retired folders
scenario: 1) Retired folders: one with a generated README only, one with a user file, one with a user-edited README; prune twice; re-run materializeTenantTree over a user README.
expected: 1) Only the generated-only folder is removed; user content kept; second prune returns []; user README never overwritten.

title: Reliability: git not installed on bind, cleanup failures never block activation
scenario: 1) Git executable fails with ENOENT during bindTenantToGit on an empty folder. 2) pruneRetiredComponentFolders or materializeTenantTree throws for one tenant, and readDirectory of the workspace root throws inside renameSuffixedFolders.
expected: 1) Rejects with GitNotFoundError telling the user to install Git; no marker written and no tenant data deleted. 2) migrateWorkspace still resolves with a report; other tenants are processed; no exception reaches the caller.

title: Path handling: win32-only case-insensitive containment, forward-slash tenant paths
scenario: 1) Stub process.platform to win32 then linux; compare Uri paths '/c:/Ws' vs '/C:/ws/Env/T' and '/c:/WS2'. 2) tenantPath(root,'Business Config/BusinessConfig.json') for file:///c%3A/ws/env/t and file:///home/u/ws; isTenantConfigPath with backslash and forward-slash fsPaths.
expected: 1) win32: differently cased path is contained, sibling prefix is not; linux: case difference is not contained; separator always '/'. 2) Result is Uri.joinPath of segments (no doubled or backslash separators), spaces preserved; isTenantConfigPath accepts both separator styles.
